reportTitle: Vercel Preview Deployment & Security Verification Report

localDevelopment.evidence: All assets (shell.css, login.css, auth.js, router.js, stock_data.js, app.js) returned HTTP 200/304 locally

vercelPreview.notes: Preview testing is held as NOT_RUN until Vercel Deployment Protection is activated or synthetic data is substituted to prevent proprietary stock leakage.

production.notes: Main branch is strictly protected. No merge permitted from Phase A.

securityGatePolicy.preDeploymentRule: Before enabling public Vercel Preview with live stock_data.js, administrator must either: (1) Enable Vercel Deployment Protection (password or SSO), OR (2) Replace stock_data.js with sanitized synthetic dataset.
